entries.e4c33d3ac0eaabb7: A business that develops, manufactures and sells automatic control equipment, measuring instruments, information equipment and related electronic application equipment, optoelectronic equipment, and systems that use them. It handles sensors for factory automation, measuring instruments, image system equipment, laser markers, microscopes for research and development, and code readers for logistics and retail. KEYENCE CORPORATION itself develops, manufactures and sells products, KEYENCE Software Co., Ltd. handles software development for the products, and KEYENCE Engineering Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing the products. The securities report omits product- and service-specific information on the grounds that sales to external customers from a single product or service category exceed 90% of net sales in the consolidated statement of income, and most of consolidated revenue of ¥1,169,289 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 comes from this business.
